column1: # Replika Delay (module 0x5A, Effects/RDelay, saved v0x12) native Kontakt 8 capture; Kontakt version 8.13.1.
# NOT A VECTOR FOR THE LISTED PARAMETERS. Two renders: every step (INIT, TYPE 0 + TIME 500000 + FEEDBACK 500000,
#   TIME alone, FEEDBACK 0, SATURATION 1000000, HIGHCUT 0) gave the same output as the INIT baseline (repeats at
#   496.3, 1003.9, 1496.4, 2004.0 ms; L rms -59.78 dB; R exactly 0). The reload path (set_engine_par in an init script,
#   script cleared, save_instrument, kt.load_instrument) moved no output. Frame data below is the INIT output.
# Parameter path tried: reload. Per step: fresh instrument, INIT preset in insert slot 0, init script
#   set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_RDL_x, raw, -1, 0, 0), script cleared, save_instrument, then kt.load_instrument.
#   Step n's note is on MIDI channel n (the loaded instrument index was 128*(n-1)). See <name>.controls.tsv.
# Stimulus: one 0.5 unit impulse at sample 0 (left channel, float32), then silence; the note is held for 6 s.
#   Recorded at 48000 Hz, float32 stereo, from Kontakt's PipeWire null sink monitor. Kontakt's group pan law
#   (0.7677) and instrument volume (0 dB) are in the path. Block size: not set by this harness, not recorded.
# Frame 0 = impulse onset: largest single-sample jump of L+R near the scheduled note (onset_frame 145795 in the
#   recording for the baseline; the jump is 0.38383 in controls.tsv). Frames 0.. are the output from that onset.
# Frames: 120000 at 48000 Hz (2.5 s). Columns: frame, L, R. R is exactly 0 in every step.
